tagline: Lakewatch now supports streaming detection rules, which evaluate each new row of a source table as it arrives and create a signal for every row that matches a SQL predicate.
what_it_does: Lakewatch now supports streaming detection rules, which evaluate each new row of a source table as it arrives and create a signal for every row that matches a SQL predicate. Use them for low latency signature, indicator of compromise (IOC), and atomic signal detections. Lakewatch manages the compute, so you don't select a SQL warehouse or a schedule.
